company.name: Vestris
company.shortDescription: Vestris provides AI agents that automate real estate title and closing workflows from contract intake to closing readiness.
company.description: Vestris is a real estate technology and artificial intelligence company that develops an AI-powered title search and real estate transaction automation platform that automates the real estate title and closing workflow. The platform ingests ratified contracts, parses documents, and creates structured addendums. It opens portals for agents, buyers, and sellers, collects required information, and manages related communication. Browser-based agents log into county and tax systems to pull records and support tax, water, and HOA proration. Vestris generates title abstracts, drafts Schedules A and B, and assembles title commitments for underwriter review. It also reconciles settlement statements, balances files, and reviews closing disclosures to assemble lender-ready packages for title and settlement firms.
